flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati and clear any saved data so the app starts empty.
Add a person named Ana.
Add a person named Ben.
Add a person named Cy.
Add a bill with amount 1,000.01 split by percentage: Ana 50, Ben 30, Cy 20, then view the per-person shares.
Assert Ana's share shows 500.01.
Assert Ben's share shows 300.00.
Assert Cy's share shows 200.00.
Get the three shares shown for Ana, Ben and Cy, in that order, as visible text and save as {{percentage_split_shares}}.
